A bull on a fire escape. Union Stock Yards. Chicago. 1956

While trying to escape from the Hygrade Packing Plant at the Union Stockyards, this bull fell out of the abattoir and ended up on this fire escape. Many of the packing plants were located on multiple levels, so it wasn’t uncommon for animals to fall from upper stories when trying to escape. The bull was apparently shot.
